input.title: Run and summarize fmDT sweep and speech metrics
input.description:
Operate only on the fmDT subfolder in /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/DTDM_Unet. Preserve all pre-existing dirty-tree work.

1. Discover fmDT/run.sh and submit it with sbatch as its five-configuration Slurm array; each configuration may take 24 hours. Record the array and task job IDs.
2. Wait for every run task to finish successfully. Invoke /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/DTDM_Unet/extract_metrics_paths.py with the fmDT/run.sh path. Process every emitted gen/out pair from the Hydra sweep. For every pair, set fmDT/metrics.sh gen and out (environment overrides are acceptable where supported) and submit it, preserving its gt path and metric commands. Record every mapping and job ID.
3. Read /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/codex_whisper/NOTES.md. For every emitted gen directory, compute per-WAV WER with Whisper large-v3 and the specified transcript in GPU Slurm jobs, writing stem_wer_l.txt beside each WAV.
4. Read /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/codex_utmosv2/NOTES.md. For every emitted gen directory, compute UTMOSv2 with the established environment/tools in GPU Slurm jobs, writing stem_utmosv2.txt beside each WAV.
5. Wait for metrics, WER, and UTMOSv2 jobs to succeed. Validate output coverage against each gen directory WAV count. Inspect actual output formats, then summarize MCD, logF0/F0, WER, and UTMOSv2 per gen path with count, arithmetic mean, and standard deviation. Save machine-readable CSV and readable Markdown under /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/DTDM_Unet/.symphony/results/, including folder, sweep/gen path, counts, means, standard deviations, all Slurm job IDs, and genuine missing values.

Follow WORKFLOW_02_aug.md, including its fmDT training-loss requirement, but this issue explicitly narrows the inventory to fmDT only and overrides the workflow's broader all-folder/scorex0 language. Use dependency-aware Slurm jobs. Never run training, inference, metrics, WER, UTMOSv2, Codex, or long polling on a login node. Check sacct exit states and logs, retry safe transient failures, and report persistent failures accurately. Keep exactly one Linear workpad comment current, post the final report there, and move this issue to Done only after all requested outputs and summaries are complete.
